title: Australian Lamb Skewers
description: A classic Australian dish, these lamb skewers are easy to make and full of flavor. Perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with marinade.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until lamb is cooked to desired level of doneness.
Let skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides.
